comments.author: Kibae
comments.story: I fooled millions into thinking chocolate helps weight loss (2015)
comments.text: I remember growing up in Canada, there were commercials about "house hippos" [1] and the first time I saw the commercial, I actually believed what was being presented. Thinking back, I think the campaign actually worked on me because it made me realize how obviously fake things can be made to seem real if it's presented by a seemingly authoritative figure.
